rows.text: In fact I have noticed a marked battery improvement as well. This is supposedly due to the much smaller and more efficient and faster chipset used. Not sure if that's it, but it certainly was a welcome change of pace. You can squeeze a bit more juice out of your phone by changing the screen brightness and resolution without missing out on much at all. I keep mine at the setting that came stock (which is not the highest resolution out of the box, strangely enough) because I cannot tell a difference. There are also different performance settings for gaming and whatnot that can drastically reduce battery length, so keep that in mind. I tried playing with the Iris scanner and fingerprint reader. My honest belief is this: while its probably important to keep security on your device, I tend to have none.

Arrived new in box. I was expecting a new product but based on some other reviews, I wasn't sure what i was going to get. It arrived in the original packaging, unopened. Still getting used to the phone but the screen and quality seem really good.

More bad than good.. Purchased 3 weeks before pre-order. I've had it since it was released, so I have 2 months experience battling with this phone. I'll start with the few good things I have to say. I love the screen resolution and clarity. I love the camera, especially shooting video in 60FPS. Its also very responsive and quick, and the battery lasts forever. And that's all I have to say about that... The bad- No screen protector works. I've never cracked a screen on a phone. Ever. I've went through 5 screen protectors in 2 months trying to protect this $800+ investment. The screen is horrible in design, and makes protecting it impossible, and makes cracking extremely easy. A 2 year payment plan is just stupid on this device, because it will never last that long without breaking.

The screen images are crystal clear and I can easily see images with the large 6. I have had my Samsung Galaxy 8 plus for two weeks. The screen images are crystal clear and I can easily see images with the large 6.2 inch display. While it is a good phone, I can't find anything to justify paying over a thousand dollars after tax and accessories.

Check carefully upon arrival.. The item we received was counterfeit. It did not wireless charge. Great investment no regrets. 6/20/2018 Edit: (Revised Thoughts) Forgot to mention I'm just an average teen who saved up for this phone I'm not dolling up the review, but for extra here are some negatives & positives in the phone's design: -Type C charger, completely different from the signature android & sensitive like iPhone's but still way better (I shared my charger and someone pulled it at an angle which bent it & charges my phone very slow like 3-4 hrs to hit 100% slow) -The glass is strong it'll take more than 5 fatal falls to crack -No sharp/flat edges if you have a screen protector few cases will peel the edges 8/15/2018

Got a Verizon screen at first, but it was unlocked & Tracfone OK. Great condition.. This is the first time I bought a reconditioned phone, and also the first time I got one that was unlocked. I was a bit apprehensive on both counts, especailly after reading some of the reviews. But I decided to order anyway, and I'm glad that I did. The phone arrived in great condition without a single scratch, mark, dent, or anything that I could see - it honestly looked like new. Turning it on for the first time it did come up with the Verizon welcome screen, so I was a bit worried that it might not be unlocked, but there was no need to be. I installed the SIM that I got from Tracfone (I decided to use the AT&T network), and started up. Before long a notice popped up that the SIM card had changed, and that the system would need to be cleared to use it.
Love it so far. Beautiful screen. Iris unlock is really cool and fast. Battery seems to last much longer than previous generations. Dual sim seems to work well with att and freedompop.

As described. Works great. Was unlocked. Was the specific model.. It wasn't perfect, no, but I didn't pay for perfect. I also didn't pay for an included usb-c cable or charger, yet they were included at no extra cost. I got more than my money's worth. What surprised me was the perfect screen with perfect pixels. Wasn't expecting that.

Exceptionally beautiful smartphone.. This smartphone is exceptionally beautiful. The infinity display is. Marvel to look at. I bought the phone for a client and it was love at first glance. As I'm writing this review I have ordered another one for another client!

As for the phone itself, I'm coming from an LG V10 that was already phenomenal in my opinion. I was worried that this phone wouldn't be much of a step up because the V10 already had great specs. I was immediately satisfied and it definitely felt like an upgrade to me. The phone felt much snappier, the screen is magnificent, the battery life is fantastic (for my own personal use), both the front and rear cameras are fast and take amazing photos and videos, and the look and feel is superb. The mono speaker is fine, but nothing too amazing. The best thing about this phone, personally, is the screen. It's the best display I've seen on a phone (once again, personally). All in all, this is a monster of a device.
